summary: DoT pressure (Corruption, Immolate, Curse of Agony) plus Fear and pet utility: the Voidwalker's shield and sacrifice and the Imp's Blood Pact stamina buff. Note the Succubus and its Seduction come from a level-20 quest, so a 19 warlock leans on Voidwalker and Imp. Skill- and comp-dependent.
factionNotes: Warlocks play both factions - Undead (Horde) Will of the Forsaken guards against fear, charm, and sleep, while Gnome (Alliance) Escape Artist frees them from roots and snares. Verify current racial and pet/quest specifics against the Wowhead Warlock guide at authoring.
